he floor here, with an identical one in the ceiling above it.

records.description:
he walls of this wide passage are made of close-fitting sandstone
locks, each as long as a human is tall, and half as thick. The floor
s lined with rectangular tiles, the cracks between them filled with
ust and sand. The atmosphere in the pyramid is one of claustrophobic
alevolence, as if evil creatures were lurking at every turn, and the
yramid itself were a hateful entity.

then eight feet high. Bunks clutter the area, placed here and there
without any rhyme or reason. Small bugs can be seen crawling in and
out of the mattresses stained with the sweat and grime of the orcs.

then eight feet high. Bunks clutter the area, placed here and there
without any rhyme or reason. Small bugs can be seen crawling in and
out of the mattresses stained with the sweat and grime of the orcs.

librarium_evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

large it is due to the thick darkness.

records.description:
The lake water flows up to a fairly solid ground mass here. A thick
coat of slime covers every square inch of the ground, making it
treacherous to pass at best. Low, uneven rumbles shake the tunnel
walls slightly, but you don't get the feeling its going to shake them
apart, rather that something large is passing nearby.

stalactites. Steady dripping, and the occasional splashing sound are
about all you hear as you pass through the area. The lake spreads out
into various directions, and you can't get an accurate feel for how
large it is due to the thick darkness.

Amazons and slaves rush past you on this busy street.  To the west you
hear the sounds of money being counted, and dents being pounded out of
armour.  To the east you can see a large temple rising up into the
sky.  Directly north of you is one of the large pyramids that dominate

shellfish liter the reef's surface. Walking is a little awkward as the

Often, a large shape is visible in the waters beyond the reef.
ye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

records.description:
A large stout tower rises above everything in the area. The door is
nothing more than a large hole in the back. You notice strategically
placed holes in the sides that are smaller in size. They look as if
they could be used to throw a weapon or rock through and still protect
you fairly well from outside attack.
ye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.
o the southeast, a wavering image of paradise shimmers in the heat.

eiling, leaving an occasional icy glitter on the walls.
verhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel
ye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

the long mountain trek, unsure of your destination, or of what could
lie in wait. You can only guess the path leads to the top, where the
black cloud blocks your view of the top.
ye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

records.description:
Each step up the path seems to test your stamina as the cold winds
blow down from the mountain top. You find yourself struggling to do
the long mountain trek, unsure of your destination, or of what could
lie in wait. You can only guess the path leads to the top, where the
black cloud blocks your view of the top.
he cliff you stand on seems stable enough, however it does little to
elp against the blistering waves of heat that rise up from the lava.

records.description:
Sun filters through the plush canopy hundreds feet above creating
beams of dusty light in the warm jungle mist all around. Birds and
small animals chatter endlessly in the background, though a single one
cannot be spotted at ground level. Strange blue-green ferns and vines
with long nail like spines cover most of the ground only allowing you
to traverse the small winding slightly worn trail.

records.description:
Something about the way the light is swallowed by the darkness here
makes the caverns appear small. You almost feel crushed as if the
massive weight of the mountain above you were about to give way. With
each step the tunnel seems to grow smaller and you catch yourself
breathing shallowly as if to fit through a tight crevice. The dark
cavern leads onward, inviting you deeper into its maw.

librarium_evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

records.description:
Something about the way the light is swallowed by the darkness here
makes the caverns appear small. You almost feel crushed as if the
massive weight of the mountain above you were about to give way. With
each step the tunnel seems to grow smaller and you catch yourself
breathing shallowly as if to fit through a tight crevice. The dark
cavern leads onward, inviting you deeper into its maw.
imilarity of the passages makes it difficult to navigate.

records.description:
Something about the way the light is swallowed by the darkness here
makes the caverns appear small. You almost feel crushed as if the
massive weight of the mountain above you were about to give way. With
each step the tunnel seems to grow smaller and you catch yourself
breathing shallowly as if to fit through a tight crevice. The dark
cavern leads onward, inviting you deeper into its maw.

records.description:
his long, low-ceilinged tunnel is supported by heavy wooden beams
hat run up the walls and cross the ceiling. The tunnel walls
hemselves are made of a brownish-red rock, run through with thin
eins of glittering diamond too small to mine.
alevolence, as if evil creatures were lurking at every turn, and the
yramid itself were a hateful entity.
imilarity of the passages makes it difficult to navigate.

records.description:
Something about the way the light is swallowed by the darkness here
makes the caverns appear small. You almost feel crushed as if the
massive weight of the mountain above you were about to give way. With
each step the tunnel seems to grow smaller and you catch yourself
breathing shallowly as if to fit through a tight crevice. The dark
cavern leads onward, inviting you deeper into its maw.
imilarity of the passages makes it difficult to navigate.

dimmed here, as if the stone darkens it to blot it out. You get an
uneasy feeling in the pit of your stomach, as if some great awful
something were to jump out and devour you in an instant. Your knees
begin to shake and you seriously question if adventuring was the life

records.description:
The silence is oppresive here. Every step you take seems to be
shallowed by the darkness around you. Even the brightest light is
dimmed here, as if the stone darkens it to blot it out. You get an
uneasy feeling in the pit of your stomach, as if some great awful
something were to jump out and devour you in an instant. Your knees
begin to shake and you seriously question if adventuring was the life

ago. It appears dormant now but you can see all along the walls where
the lava tattooed the rock with super hot magma. You notice the
temperature seems to raise the farther west you go, and you wonder if
the source of the lava is still dormant as well.

the volcano. This set of tunnels is so close to the heart, that they
glow with a soft red glow. Traveling the insides of an active volcano
leaves you feeling so overheated that you have little energy. Your
clothes are thoroughly soaked in perspiration. Occasionally you find
closed doors, which seem very out of place. Thick steam flows through

records.description:
A half moon shaped strip of sand lies between the water and the stout
rocky cliffs. The cliffs are steep enough that you are not able to
climb them here. The sand is a fine powdery white, contrasting against
the blue-green water. From here you can look out across the ocean. You
can barely make out another island to the east. A thick mist hangs
above the water and obscures your view.

walk across it. Small tide pools filled with small crabs and other
shellfish liter the reef's surface. Walking is a little awkward as the
rough coral edges make your footing less stable then you would like.
Often, a large shape is visible in the waters beyond the reef.

the prized portions of a number of different water creatures. A long
bench sits near the back wall, with a massive wooden tub of water
behind it. In the tub sits a merman smiling warmly at you while
polishing a huge clam shell. A well crafted ladder allows passage down
through a small open trap door beside the counter.

thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes.

records.description:
Magma still flows lightly through these deep tunnels. At times you are
avoiding steping into thin flowing streams, at others the magma is
dripping on you from above. It is so unbearably hot here, your armour
begins to meld to your skin. Every rupture and shake of the walls
promises a seering hot cave-in. You can barely see through the
thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes. You think you hear the
ounds of cruel female laughter in the distance.

dripping on you from above. It is so unbearably hot here, your armour
begins to meld to your skin. Every rupture and shake of the walls
promises a seering hot cave-in. You can barely see through the
thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes.

dripping on you from above. It is so unbearably hot here, your armour
begins to meld to your skin. Every rupture and shake of the walls
promises a seering hot cave-in. You can barely see through the
thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes.

records.description:

avoiding steping into thin flowing streams, at others the magma is
dripping on you from above. It is so unbearably hot here, your armour
begins to meld to your skin. Every rupture and shake of the walls
promises a seering hot cave-in. You can barely see through the
thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes.
ave been gouged into the walls. Bones and debris litter the tunnel.

promises a seering hot cave-in. You can barely see through the
thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes.

baby blanket inside.  There is a faded picture of the farmer and his
ife smiling, on the front stoop of the farmhouse.

with cookpots almost set to boil. You sense you are being watched yet

cautious steps from here, for angering the gypsyies has ended many
a foolish life.

A large wagon resides to the northeast, a large elaborate symbol
on the front of the door, you assume this is home of the gypsy leader.

Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the
ground as the wind shifts. There is an abnormal chill that reaches
deep into your bones as you travel through here. To the north and
east of you is a small mountain range. The cliffs are steep and
covered in a slick ice, making them impossible to climb with the

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
Blasts of galacial wind assail you, as you hang on for dear life up in
the crow's nest. Nothing living has been here for a very long time, or
at least so say the yellowed bones scattered all around. The skulls
seem to stare towards you, as the freezing cold numbs your body.
lack cloud blocks your view of the top.
he cliff you stand on seems stable enough, however it does little to
elp against the blistering waves of heat that rise up from the lava.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could

prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.
